description: This script initializes Ethernet MAC addresses for specific device boards during system startup or configuration. It checks device models, reads hardware addresses from sysfs, and sets environment variables accordingly.

methods.name: board_name
methods.description: Determines the board name for device-specific configuration.

methods.name: fw_printenv
methods.description: Reads environment variables from firmware environment storage.

methods.name: fw_setenv
methods.description: Sets environment variables in firmware environment storage.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Adds a numerical value to a MAC address string.
